top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children are left in buggies longer than fiftteen minutes which is the maximum time frame a child may be in a restrictive device.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
